name: Ginger Beef, Bell Pepper & Cabbage Stir-Fry with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and riced cauliflower. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, 5-6 minutes. Transfer cauliflower rice to a plate and cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
When the beef is done, add shredded cabbage and stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage has softened, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Top with beef stir-fry and enjoy!
author: Mealime
